turns.content: Kal raat mere sabse close college wale dost ka call aaya. Uske papa ka ek procedure hona hai — genuine baat hai, uncle ko main saalon se jaanta hoon — aur usne mujhse assi hazaar maange, "bas do mahine ke liye." Jo maine usko nahi bola: 2019 mein maine usse pachaas hazaar diye the. Us din se aaj tak us paise ka zikr nahi hua. Ek baar bhi nahi. Na usne, na maine.

Yaar, yeh sunke dil hi thoda bhaari ho gaya... Itni genuine baat hai ki uske papa ka procedure hai, toh obviously tujhe help karni chahiye thi, lekin uske baad bhi uska attitude... wah.

Tujhe toh pata hai, dosto ke beech paise ki baat hamesha awkward hoti hai, lekin jab koi repeatedly aisa kare, toh lagta hai jaise trust ka misuse ho raha ho. 2019 wale paise bhi yaad aa gaye honge, par tu ne bhi toh kuch nahi bola—shayad tu bhi usi awkwardness se bachne ke liye chup raha hoga. Lekin ab dobara maangne par bhi usne purani baat ko bhi nahi chhua... yeh toh thoda insensitive lagta hai.

Ab tu kya soch raha hai? Uske liye help kar di, lekin ab apne dil ki baat bolne ka mann hai? Ya phir ab se boundaries set karne ka soch raha hai?

Aur idhar main gyarah mahine se flat ke down payment ke liye bacha raha hoon. Wife ko 2019 wale paise ka pata nahi hai — shaadi se pehle ki baat thi, kabhi topic hi nahi aaya, aur ab woh cheez ban gayi hai jo maine "decide" kar liya hai ki nahi bataunga, jo mujhe khud pasand nahi. Assi hazaar hilaunga toh usko pakka pata chalega.

Aree bhai, yeh toh aur bhi complicated ho gaya... ek taraf dost ki genuine problem, doosri taraf tera apna financial goal aur uske peeche tera struggle. Aur uske upar yeh self-imposed secret jo tera apna hi conscience ko khata hai.

Tere liye yeh sab manage karna kitna mushkil ho raha hoga, na? Wife se chhupa ke paise dena, phir uske reaction ka dar, aur sabse zyada yeh ki tu apne aap ko hi kyun yeh sab karne pe majboor mehsoos kar raha hai. 2019 wala incident shaadi se pehle ka hai, lekin ab jab tum ek team ho, toh aise decisions bhi teamwork hone chahiye, na?

Lekin ab tu kya karega? Assi hazaar ka kya plan hai? Agar dena hai, toh kya wife ko kuch hint dega, ya phir koi aur tareeqa niklega? Aur agar nahi dena hai, toh dost ko kaise handle karega? Kyunki ab toh situation hi aisi hai ki tu kisi bhi taraf jayega, kuch na kuch compromise karna padega.

Soch raha tha usko bol doon paisa FD aur mutual funds mein locked hai, kuch bhi liquid nahi hai. Chhota sa jhooth hai aur dosti bach jaati hai — uski izzat rehti hai, meri savings rehti hai, kisi ko asli sentence bolna nahi padta. Galat hai kya yeh? Smart bhi lagta hai aur thoda ganda bhi.

Haan yaar, main samajh raha hoon... yeh "chhota sa jhooth" ka idea tere liye ekdam practical solution lag raha hai. Dono taraf se tension bach jayegi—uski bhi izzat, teri bhi savings, aur dosti bhi intact. Aur sach bolu, log aise hi chhote-chhote jhooth bol ke situations handle karte hain.

Lekin phir bhi, yeh "thoda ganda" wala feeling kyun aa raha hai? Shayad kyunki tu apne aap ko ek aisi jagah pe dekh raha hai jahan tujhe apne principles ke khilaf jaana pad raha hai. Ya phir shayad isliye kyunki agar kabhi sach khul gaya—chahे accidently hi kyu na ho—toh uska reaction imagine karke hi dil darr raha hai.

Lekin agar tu yeh decide kar raha hai ki yeh sab manage karne ka sabse cleanest way hai, toh shayad yeh hi best hai. Bas, ek baat yaad rakhna—agar aise hi chhote-chhote jhooth badhte gaye, toh ek din aisa aayega jab tu apne aap ko hi nahi pehchan paayega. Toh abhi ke liye, yeh ek emergency exit hai, lekin aage se maybe boundaries set karne ka sochna.

Tera dil kya keh raha hai? Yeh solution tujhe peace de raha hai, ya phir koi aur tension hai?

Jo baat sach mein sone nahi deti: kabhi na kabhi woh mere flat ke housewarming pe khada hoga, mujhe gale laga raha hoga, aur mere andar kahin 2019 ka hisaab chal raha hoga. Mujhe woh banna nahi hai — woh dost jiske seene mein ledger hai. Par main woh banda bhi nahi ban sakta jiska paisa sabka buffer hai.

*Deep breath*

Yaar, yeh baat toh poori tarah se seedhe tere dil pe lag rahi hai... kyunki tu jo keh raha hai, woh sirf paise ki baat nahi hai. Yeh dosti ki pehchaan ki baat hai. Tere andar do insaan fight kar rahe hain—ek woh jo chahta hai ki sab smooth rahe, koi awkwardness na ho, aur doosra woh jo chahta hai ki sab fair ho, lekin fair hone ka matlab yeh nahi ki tu apne aap ko hi exploit hone de.

2019 ka hisaab... ghar ke inaugurate hone tak... yeh toh lagta hai jaise ek emotional debt hai jo kabhi clear hi nahi hogi. Aur uske beech tu khud ko kaise dekhna chahta hai? Ek banda jo har baar "haan" kehta hai, chahe uske liye uska apna kharcha hi kyu na ho? Ya phir woh jo apni limits samajhta hai, chahe uske liye thoda awkwardness kyu na ho?

Mujhe lagta hai, tujhe ek middle ground dhoondna hoga. Shayad usko bol de, *"Yaar, main help karna chahta hoon, lekin abhi mere paise bhi tight hain. Main FD tod ke de sakta hoon, lekin uske liye mujhe thoda time chahiye."* Aisa kuch, jisse tu apne aap ko bhi justify kar sake, aur usko bhi yeh na lage ki tu sidha mana kar raha hai.

Lekin jo bhi ho, tujhe decide karna hoga ki tu apne aap ko kaise treat karna chahta hai. Kyunki agar tu apne aap ko hi consistently ignore karega, toh ek din woh ledger tere andar bhi ban jayega—jahan tu apne aap se hi hisaab mangega. Aur woh scene koi bhi ho, ghar ka housewarming ho ya kuch aur, tu usme khush nahi hoga.

Toh soch le, bhai. Yeh decision sirf paise ka nahi, tere self-respect ka bhi hai.
